name: Muse Ember 1.0
short: Meta's smallest, most efficient reasoning model, revealed 2026-11-09 behind the Crouton Alpha stealth preview — 1M ctx, multimodal in; the first model trained using Muse Wonder Full.
modalities: Text, image, audio, video in; text out
standout: Efficiency frontier: more intelligence per dollar than Claude Haiku 5.5 or GPT-6 Luna at every reasoning setting — $0.116–0.136 per Artificial Analysis task (Meta, 2026-11-09).
tradeoff: A small model by design — on the hardest novel problems it trails the frontier (FrontierCode 2.0-AA 27.2% vs Haiku 5.5's 34.9%); pair it with Muse Wonder for those.
